Use $E^{\ominus}$ values to explain these observations.

parts.text:
Tartaric acid reacts with the amine 1-phenylethylamine, $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{CH}(\text{NH}_2)\text{CH}_3$, to form an ionic salt.
